name: Running Away Balloon
look: Two stacked cartoon panels. Top: a simple white figure grins and reaches both arms toward a big yellow balloon drifting away. Bottom: a pink blob creature hugs the white figure from behind, holding him back, while he keeps reaching for the balloon with a nervous sweat drop.
use: The white figure is someone chasing a goal and the yellow balloon is the goal. In the second panel the pink creature is the habit, temptation or obstacle that holds them back as the goal floats off.
slots: what holds them back (pink creature, bottom)
